review_notes: I read the whole 41-line file. It has one theorem. Its proof is a single term application of `AlgebraicCurve.degree_canonicalDivisor_eq_of_riemannRoch`. It has no `simp`, `simp only`, `simp_rw` or `@[simp]` use, and it defines no simp lemmas of its own. The only simp-related content is the long `attribute [-simp] ...` blocks, which switch off many simp lemmas from other files. They have no effect on a term-mode proof. They look like generated boilerplate that isolates the file from the surrounding project. I did not open those lemma definitions or check their orientation. The file gives no concrete expression, desired normal form, competing rule or loop to support a simp-interface complaint, so I report no finding. I did not check whether the disabled lemmas are badly oriented in their home files, and that is the remaining uncertainty.
